name: ros2_controllers joint trajectory controller implementation
summary: Official C++ ros2_control lifecycle plugin that accepts joint-space trajectory topic/action input, samples trajectories and writes claimed joint command interfaces. The selected source includes goal validation, tolerances and action/state feedback; no robot or successful task execution was verified.

Verification is limited to the selected source text, not all dependencies, companion implementations, binaries, hardware drivers or deployment.

packages: Complete pinned joint_trajectory_controller package, companion sources/headers and a C++17 toolchain
system: Configured ros2_control controller manager/lifecycle host, named joints and matching claimed command/state interfaces
Complete generated parameters, trajectory helpers, robot description and applicable joint/goal constraints
requirements.notes: The selected update reads joint states, samples the companion Trajectory implementation, checks configured tolerances and writes position, velocity, acceleration or effort commands according to selected interfaces. Velocity-only or effort-only configurations can use the PID/feedforward adapter. Configuration creates ~/joint_trajectory input, ~/controller_state output, follow_joint_trajectory action, query_state service and conditional speed-scaling input. It handles goal preemption/cancellation and configured hold/deceleration paths; stopping safety and real-time performance were not tested. Companion trajectory.cpp, headers, generated parameter YAML/validators and their behavior are required but were not reviewed. lifecycle_msgs is explicitly included in this source; the other listed build/runtime dependencies come from package.xml/CMake. Optional BUILD_TESTING has additional declared test dependencies. CMake requests C++17; package 4.43.0 and the jazzy checkout are declarations, not tested ROS, OS, architecture, controller or robot combinations.

invocation.notes: The plugin XML registers type joint_trajectory_controller::JointTrajectoryController and shared library joint_trajectory_controller. The source exports that class with PLUGINLIB_EXPORT_CLASS. A configured controller manager/lifecycle host calls on_configure/on_activate/update; this is not a standalone ros2 run program or a Hub recipe. Joint-space trajectory construction and kinematics remain caller/package responsibilities. Loading an appropriately configured host can write actual hardware command interfaces. The Hub retrieves one inert file only and did not build, load or execute the plugin.

access.instructions: Read the immutable source, complete license, package/CMake/plugin registration and complete upstream configuration before integration. This source-only reference supplies no build, install or execution adapter.
